description: Complete Netflix-style web app redesign. Rebuild all components and pages with Netflix UX patterns: full-bleed hero banners with backdrop images, horizontal content rails with scroll arrows, poster cards with hover zoom and info overlay, a sticky transparent-to-solid navbar, and cinematic detail pages. All using shadcn/ui patterns (cn utility, CVA variants) and the new Tailwind tokens.
steps: Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/Layout.jsx` as a Netflix-style shell: sticky navbar that transitions from transparent to solid #141414 on scroll, Netflix-red logo 'HIJISTREAM', horizontal nav links (Home, Movies, TV Shows), search icon and mobile hamburger menu. Footer minimal. Use cn() utility throughout.

Create `apps/web/src/components/HeroBanner.jsx` - a full-width hero component that takes a featured movie/show item with its backdrop_url as background (full bleed, height ~70vh on desktop, ~50vh mobile), gradient overlay from transparent to #141414, title in bold large text, overview text truncated to 2-3 lines, genre pills, Play button (white bg, black text, rounded) and More Info button (gray/transparent bg, white text). Include a subtle Ken Burns zoom animation on the backdrop.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/ContentCard.jsx` as a Netflix poster card: aspect-ratio 2:3 poster image filling the card, on hover scale up to 1.3x with smooth transition, show an expanded info card below/overlaid with title, year, rating (green percentage or star), genre tags, and a small play icon. No border in default state - just the poster. Card background #181818 only shows on hover expansion. Use cn() for conditional classes.

Create `apps/web/src/components/ContentRail.jsx` - a horizontal scrolling rail component (replaces HorizontalScroll and ContentGrid for home page). Shows a section title, optional 'See All >' link, and a row of ContentCards that scroll horizontally. Include left/right chevron arrow buttons that appear on hover (Netflix-style scroll arrows at the edges). Uses scrollbar-hide. Cards should be approximately 180px wide on desktop.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/ContentGrid.jsx` to use the new ContentCard styling. Keep the responsive grid layout (2/3/4/5/6 columns) for browse pages (Movies, TV). Ensure it still accepts items, type, isLoading, error, onRetry props.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/DetailHero.jsx` as a cinematic full-bleed detail page header: full-width backdrop image (or gradient fallback) taking top 60% of viewport, deep gradient fade to #141414 at bottom, poster positioned at bottom-left overlapping the backdrop fade, title large and bold to the right of poster, metadata row (year, rating with colored badge, runtime/seasons), genre pills, overview paragraph, cast section with circular avatar placeholders, and a large Play button (white bg, black text, Netflix style) + secondary button. All positioned over the fading backdrop.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/EpisodeList.jsx` with Netflix styling: season selector as a dropdown with dark styling, episode rows with thumbnail (still_path), episode number, title, air date, runtime, and overview. Play button appears on hover over thumbnail. Dark card backgrounds with subtle borders.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/TabNavigation.jsx` as Netflix-style filter tabs: horizontal scroll, active tab is white text with a red underline (#E50914), inactive is gray text. No background pills - just text + underline.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/SearchBar.jsx` with Netflix search styling: expandable search field that starts as just a search icon, expands on click to a full input field with a dark background and subtle border, right-aligned in the navbar ideally. Clear button on the right. Keep existing search history dropdown but style it darker.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/LoadingState.jsx` with Netflix-style skeleton loaders: dark gray shimmer cards matching the poster card dimensions for grid/rail, and a full hero skeleton for detail pages.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/ErrorState.jsx` with Netflix error styling: centered message on dark background, Netflix-red accent on the retry button.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/components/VideoPlayer.jsx` maintaining exact same functionality (iframe embed from vaplayer.ru, watch progress tracking via postMessage) but with Netflix-dark chrome: black background, minimal top bar with back arrow and title, full-width video below.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/Home.jsx` with Netflix home page layout: 1) Featured HeroBanner at top showing a random trending movie (use first item from trendingMovies), 2) 'Continue Watching' rail (if items exist), 3) 'Trending Movies' rail, 4) 'Trending TV Shows' rail. Use ContentRail component for each section. No grid layout on home - only horizontal rails.

Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/Movies.jsx` with Netflix browse layout: TabNavigation at top for category switching (Popular/Trending/Top Rated/Upcoming), then ContentGrid below with infinite scroll. Keep existing useInfiniteQuery logic intact.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/TV.jsx` following same pattern as Movies.jsx redesign.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/MovieDetail.jsx` using the new DetailHero component. Keep existing query logic.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/TVDetail.jsx` using new DetailHero + new EpisodeList. Keep existing query logic for show details and season episodes.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/Search.jsx` with Netflix search page: dark background, prominent search input, results displayed in ContentGrid. Keep existing query logic.
Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/Player.jsx` using new VideoPlayer component. Keep all existing embed URL logic, keyboard shortcuts, and metadata handling intact.
Update `apps/web/index.html` meta theme-color to #141414 to match new background.
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run lint` and fix any lint errors/warnings until 0 remain
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run typecheck` and fix any type errors until 0 remain
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run build` and ensure it succeeds
Run `cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun run test` and ensure all tests pass
acceptance_criteria: Layout has a sticky navbar that appears transparent at top and solid on scroll, with HIJISTREAM in Netflix-red
Home page shows a full-bleed HeroBanner featuring a trending item, followed by horizontal content rails
ContentCard displays poster-only by default and expands with info on hover with scale animation
ContentRail has left/right scroll arrow buttons and horizontal scroll behavior
Detail pages have cinematic full-bleed backdrop heroes with gradient fade
EpisodeList has dark styling with hover-to-play thumbnails
All components use cn() utility from apps/web/src/lib/utils.js
Color palette is Netflix-inspired: #141414 background, #E50914 primary red, white text
All TMDB data integration (api calls, query keys, data shapes) is preserved exactly
Watch progress tracking (saveWatchProgress, loadWatchProgress, getAllWatchProgress) works unchanged
bun run lint passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
bun run typecheck passes with 0 errors
bun run test passes all tests
findings: All verification passed: lint 0 errors/warnings, typecheck 0 errors, build succeeds (2.24s), all 22 tests pass. Created HeroBanner and ContentRail as new components. All existing API integration, watch progress logic, routes, and test files preserved unchanged. Used cn() utility throughout, Tailwind custom tokens (bg-background, text-primary, bg-background-card, text-muted-foreground etc.), and Netflix-inspired dark theme patterns.
